name: Compiler Construction
summary: How source code becomes machine code: lexing, parsing, semantic analysis, intermediate representations, code generation and basic optimization.

topics.name: Compiler structure: front end, middle end and back end
Lexical analysis: regular expressions and finite automata
Parsing: context-free grammars, LL and recursive descent
Bottom-up parsing: LR, LALR and parser generators
Abstract syntax trees and syntax-directed translation
Semantic analysis: symbol tables and type checking
Intermediate representations: three-address code and SSA
Run-time organization: activation records and calling conventions
Code generation for a stack or register machine
Basic optimizations: constant folding and dead-code elimination
